dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hey {NICKNAME}, you'll never guess what Paimon just heard!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Yashiro Commission is holding a Test of Courage event! They've even prepared rewards for participants who can pass the event's challenges!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But uh, if it's a "Test of Courage," that means it's probably gonna be scary, right? So, if we join, Paimon's gonna let you go first...
